# Flav

> Flav is an iPhone app that saves recipes from TikTok and recipe web pages. You share a cooking video to Flav from the iPhone share sheet, or paste its link, and Flav reads the caption and the page and saves the recipe (title, ingredients with quantities, steps in order, and the video link) to a private cookbook. Cook Mode then walks you through the steps with timers.

Key facts:

- iPhone only. Not available on Android.
- How import works: Flav reads the video's caption and page. An import usually takes a few seconds; a long caption can take about 15.
- If the recipe is not written in the caption and the TikTok has captions, Flav+ writes the recipe from what is said in the video. Amounts that were not said out loud are marked (estimate).
- Free accounts get one of these video reads.
- If there is no written recipe and no captions, Flav writes its own version of the dish and labels it as Flav's version, not the creator's own.
- Flav does not watch the video itself, so on-screen text and videos with no speech are not read. That is planned for a later version.
- Instagram links are not supported yet.
- Imports are private by default.
- Cook Mode: one step at a time with timers, a Lock Screen Live Activity, and Apple Watch.
- Also: a meal plan, a grocery list built from a recipe's ingredients, and household sharing.
- Free plan: 10 AI imports a month, plus the cookbook, Cook Mode and grocery list.
- Flav+: no import limit, video reads, plus AI meal planning. $4.99 a month, $29.99 a year, or $59.99 once (lifetime), US App Store prices.
- Made by Tig Tech LLC, Austin, Texas. Support: https://flav.app/support
